chapter: Family, Margaret's story and Eutris's memories
title: Farm chores, watermelon patch and his father's 365 acres
summary: He rode cows, grew watermelons on an acre his father gave him, and says his father had 365 acres.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: The twin... Yeah, it's seven, I have it. O.K., could you tell us something like, again, about when you were younger and on the farm. What did you have to do as a kid? What was the family life like?
What was your family life like when you were very young?
Nothing but having a ball, man, out on the farm.
He wants to know, what did you do? Did you have chores? What was your chore?

(NOT CLEAR) ...I paid the guys off in watermelons. Every Saturday we would be off... So I had my watermelon patch and every time we'd get the watermelons we'd take them down - and the dam is still there, it's still there, and the walk over it. You know, I'm going to Aunt Jessie's or Aunt Margaret's or somebody and the walk over it, it's still there.
So you said you had your own watermelon patch. How large was the family plot, the farm?

You had the sandy part for watermelon, not gray dirt or black dirt. You put them in the sand. My father gave me an acre... On Saturdays we would go and get the watermelons. Then we'd start digging and the water was here and still let

the water to run and we cut down trees, and put trees and dirt and everything in there, until the water would go up. We kept that up and we put dirt in there and cut down brushes and put them in there. You'd look like you was born on the farm too. (LAUGHTER - ALL TALK AT ONCE) ... I loved it. That was on Saturdays. You got to sweep the (brush) (broom) in the morning and then we would go out and get the watermelons and put them down there. But all these brushes first, and watermelon.
He asked you how large was your father's farm? About 4 acres?
No! What? Four? Dad had 365 acres.
Really? That's a lot of land.
Yeah, he had a lot of children. (LAUGHTER)
You have to have a lot of land when you've got a lot of children. What did your brothers and sisters do? What was the regular routine every day?
